data.body: PLAN_AMENDMENT: Create the fixture directory before writing the corpus file: mkdir -p tests/fixtures/inference-incidents/. Hash function for holdout partition (used in T6b): Python hashlib.md5(ticket_id.encode()).hexdigest(), take first 8 hex chars as int (int(hash[0:8], 16)), then mod 3. Document this in a comment at the top of holdout.txt so it is reproducible.
